## Description

This figure is a screenshot of a leaderboard from the GLUE benchmark website, showing the performance of various natural language understanding models. The leaderboard ranks models based on their scores across multiple GLUE tasks. The table lists model names, URLs, scores, and various performance metrics such as CoLA, SST-2, MRPC, STS-B, QQP, MNLI-m, MNLI-mm, QNLI, RTE, and WNLI.
